title: Eigensets and invariant sets of switching dynamical systems
summary: We consider reachable sets of switching systems, which are families of linear ODE $\dot x(t) \, = \, \, A(t) \, x(t)$ with a function $A(\cdot)$ taking values on a given compact set of $d\times d$ matrices. An eigenset is a compact set $M \ne \{0\}$ that possesses the following property: the closure of the set of points reachable by trajectories $x(\cdot)$ starting from $M$ in time $t$ is equal to $e^{\, αt}M, \, t\ge 0$.
